title: Persist Tool Input/Output Using TCA Sharing
description:
# Goal
Persist each tool's input and output text so it survives app restarts and tool navigation.

## User Requirements
- **Scope**: Both input AND output text
- **Storage**: `fileStorage` (JSON files) for larger content support
- **Tools**: All 6 inputtable tools

## Architecture Overview

### Current Tool Types
| Tool | Reducer Type | Input | Output |
|------|-------------|-------|--------|
| TextCaseConverter | `InputOutputEditorsReducer` | String | String |
| PrefixSuffix | `InputOutputEditorsReducer` | String | String |
| HtmlToSwift | `InputOutputEditorsReducer` | String | String |
| SwiftPretty | `InputOutputEditorsReducer` | String | String |
| JsonPretty | `InputOutputAttributedEditorsReducer` | String | NSAttributedString* |
| RegexMatches | `InputAttributedTwoOutputAttributedEditorsReducer` | NSAttributedString* | 2x NSAttributedString* |

*For attributed text, we persist the raw `.string` value only. Formatting is re-applied on Convert.

## Implementation Approach
Use TCA's @Shared with fileStorage for automatic persistence. Pass derived Shared references to child reducers so changes auto-persist without manual sync.

### Key Pattern
```swift
@Shared(.textCaseConverterIO) var storage = ToolIOStorage()
var inputOutput: InputOutputEditorsReducer.State

public init() {
    self.inputOutput = InputOutputEditorsReducer.State(
        inputText: $storage.input,
        outputText: $storage.output
    )
}
```

## Files Overview
- **New**: `Sources/SharedModels/ToolIOStorage.swift`
- **InputOutput Module**: 7 files to modify
- **Tool Reducers**: 6 files to modify

## Reference
Full plan: /Users/atacan/.claude/plans/foamy-dreaming-bunny.md

description:
## Overview
Add fileStorage persistence to JsonPrettyReducer for input/output text. This tool uses attributed output (syntax highlighting).

## File to Modify
`Sources/JsonPrettyFeature/JsonPrettyReducer.swift`

## Current State
Uses `InputOutputAttributedEditorsReducer` with:
- Plain string input
- NSAttributedString output (syntax highlighted)

## Target Changes
```swift
@ObservableState
public struct State: Equatable {
    @Shared(.jsonPrettyIO) var storage = ToolIOStorage()
    var inputOutput: InputOutputAttributedEditorsReducer.State
    var isConversionRequestInFlight = false

    public init() {
        self.inputOutput = InputOutputAttributedEditorsReducer.State(
            inputText: $storage.input,
            outputRawText: $storage.output
        )
    }

    public init(input: String, output: String = "") {
        self._storage = Shared(wrappedValue: ToolIOStorage(input: input, output: output), .jsonPrettyIO)
        self.inputOutput = InputOutputAttributedEditorsReducer.State(
            inputText: $storage.input,
            outputRawText: $storage.output
        )
    }
}
```

## Behavior
- Input: Persists as-is (plain text)
- Output: Persists raw string only; syntax highlighting restored when user clicks "Format"
- On restore: Output shows plain text, user clicks Format to get highlighting

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Input text persists across app restarts
- [ ] Output text (raw) persists across app restarts
- [ ] "Move to other tool" still works
- [ ] Formatting/highlighting works after restore

## Dependencies
- Depends on: DevBliss-96o.1 (ToolIOStorage model)
- Depends on: DevBliss-96o.7 (InputOutputAttributedEditorsReducer Shared init)

## Notes
- Can be done **in parallel** with other tool reducer issues

title: Add persistence to RegexMatchesReducer
description:
## Overview
Add fileStorage persistence to RegexMatchesReducer for input and both output texts. This is the only tool with two outputs.

## File to Modify
`Sources/RegexMatchesFeature/RegexMatchesReducer.swift`

## Current State
Uses `InputAttributedTwoOutputAttributedEditorsReducer` with:
- NSMutableAttributedString input (with match highlighting)
- NSAttributedString output (capturing groups)
- NSAttributedString outputSecond (whole matches)

## Target Changes
```swift
@ObservableState
public struct State: Equatable {
    @Shared(.regexMatchesIO) var storage = ToolIOStorageDoubleOutput()  // Note: uses DoubleOutput variant
    var inputOutput: InputAttributedTwoOutputAttributedEditorsReducer.State
    public var regexPattern: String
    var isConversionRequestInFlight = false

    public init() {
        self.inputOutput = InputAttributedTwoOutputAttributedEditorsReducer.State(
            inputRawText: $storage.input,
            outputRawText: $storage.output,
            outputSecondRawText: $storage.outputSecond
        )
        // ... load regexPattern from userDefaults
    }

    public init(input: String, output: String = "") {
        self._storage = Shared(
            wrappedValue: ToolIOStorageDoubleOutput(input: input, output: output, outputSecond: ""),
            .regexMatchesIO
        )
        self.inputOutput = InputAttributedTwoOutputAttributedEditorsReducer.State(
            inputRawText: $storage.input,
            outputRawText: $storage.output,
            outputSecondRawText: $storage.outputSecond
        )
        self.regexPattern = ""
    }
}
```

## Behavior
- Input: Persists raw string; highlighting restored on Extract
- Output: Persists raw capturing groups
- OutputSecond: Persists raw whole matches
- On restore: All text is plain, user clicks Extract to get highlighting

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Input text persists across app restarts
- [ ] Both output texts persist across app restarts
- [ ] "Move to other tool" still works
- [ ] Regex highlighting works after restore
- [ ] Existing regexPattern persistence unaffected

## Dependencies
- Depends on: DevBliss-96o.1 (ToolIOStorage model - needs ToolIOStorageDoubleOutput)
- Depends on: DevBliss-96o.8 (InputAttributedTwoOutputAttributedEditorsReducer Shared init)

## Notes
- Only tool using `ToolIOStorageDoubleOutput` (3 fields instead of 2)
- Can be done **in parallel** with other tool reducer issues

description:
## Overview
Modify OutputEditorReducer to accept `Shared<String>` for the text property, enabling automatic persistence.

## File to Modify
`Sources/InputOutput/OutputEditorView.swift`

## Current State
```swift
@ObservableState
public struct State: Equatable {
    public var text: String
    var outputControls: OutputControlsReducer.State
    var isActivitySheetPresented: Bool = false

    public init(text: String = "", outputControls: OutputControlsReducer.State = .init()) {
        self.text = text
        self.outputControls = outputControls
    }
}
```

## Target State
```swift
@ObservableState
public struct State: Equatable {
    @Shared public var text: String
    var outputControls: OutputControlsReducer.State
    var isActivitySheetPresented: Bool = false

    public init(text: Shared<String>, outputControls: OutputControlsReducer.State = .init()) {
        self._text = text
        self.outputControls = outputControls
    }

    public init(text: String = "", outputControls: OutputControlsReducer.State = .init()) {
        self._text = Shared(value: text)
        self.outputControls = outputControls
    }
}
```

## Changes Required
1. Change `public var text: String` to `@Shared public var text: String`
2. Add new initializer that accepts `Shared<String>`
3. Keep convenience initializer for backwards compatibility
4. Update `updateText` extension methods if needed

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `text` property uses `@Shared`
- [ ] Both initializers work correctly
- [ ] Existing previews still compile
- [ ] Copy to clipboard still works (reads from state.text)

## Dependencies
- Depends on: DevBliss-96o.1 (ToolIOStorage model)

## Notes
- Can be done **in parallel** with DevBliss-96o.2 (InputEditorReducer)

title: Update InputOutputEditorsReducer with Shared-accepting initializer
Add @Shared rawText to InputAttributedEditorReducer
Add @Shared rawText to OutputAttributedEditorReducer
description:
## Overview
Add persistence support to OutputAttributedEditorReducer. Since the text is NSAttributedString, we need to persist the raw string separately.

## File to Modify
`Sources/InputOutput/OutputAttributedEditorView.swift`

## Current State
Look for OutputAttributedEditorReducer in this file. It should have:
- `text: NSAttributedString` property
- OutputControls for copy/save functionality

## Target State
```swift
@ObservableState
public struct State: Equatable {
    @Shared public var rawText: String  // Persisted
    public var text: NSAttributedString  // Display (not persisted directly)
    var outputControls: OutputControlsReducer.State
    var isActivitySheetPresented: Bool = false

    // New initializer for persistence
    public init(rawText: Shared<String>, outputControls: OutputControlsReducer.State = .init()) {
        self._rawText = rawText
        self.text = NSAttributedString(string: rawText.wrappedValue)
        self.outputControls = outputControls
    }

    // Convenience initializer
    public init(text: NSAttributedString = .init(), outputControls: OutputControlsReducer.State = .init()) {
        self._rawText = Shared(value: text.string)
        self.text = text
        self.outputControls = outputControls
    }
}
```

## Reducer Changes
Update the `updateText` method to also sync rawText:
```swift
public mutating func updateText(_ newText: NSAttributedString) -> Effect<Action> {
    text = newText
    $rawText.withLock { $0 = newText.string }
    return .none
}
```

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `rawText` is @Shared and persisted
- [ ] `text` (NSAttributedString) displays the formatted version
- [ ] When updateText is called, rawText syncs
- [ ] Copy to clipboard still works (can read from text.string or rawText)

## Dependencies
- Depends on: DevBliss-96o.1 (ToolIOStorage model)

## Notes
- Can be done **in parallel** with other editor issues
- Used by JsonPretty and RegexMatches for output
